nodes.description: NPR2 variants use several proximal routes to receptor failure. Some cause aberrant transcripts or premature truncation; some missense receptors are retained in the endoplasmic reticulum; and functional assays of other missense alleles show markedly deficient guanylyl-cyclase activity. These are convergent allelic mechanisms, not competing disease hypotheses.
